reading: `src/db` holds 203 non-test modules — 74 `seed-*.ts` scenarios and 129 query modules — plus 197 test files (10 of them `.postgres.test.ts`), for 192,189 lines of which 94,184 are tests. The layer's grammar is real but unwritten: 52 `src/lib`/`src/db` same-basename pairs (rules in lib, rows in db), a verb split of 124 `list*`/91 `get*`/18 `count*` reads against 52 `set*`/35 `record*`/27 `create*`/26 `delete*`/19 `mark*` writes, and a second kind of module — the surface reader (`today.ts`, `closeout.ts`, `roster-facts.ts`, `departures-board.ts`, `trips-overview.ts`, `boat-line.ts`) — whose "one call, no second detector" rule appears only in docblocks (`departures-board.ts:33-42`, `roster-facts.ts:22-26`) and in none of AGENTS.md, `.claude/rules/db.md` or `docs/architecture/overview.md`. Where a page lacks a reader it becomes one: `src/app/shop/[shopSlug]/page.tsx` imports 15 `@/db/` modules, `trips/[id]/manifest/page.tsx` 12, `orders/page.tsx` 10, `divers/[personId]/page.tsx` 10, and 316 files under `src/app` import `@/db/` directly. Predicates are the layer's weakest grammar: 22 tables carry `deleted_at` but only `trips` has a named predicate (`liveTrip()`, 62 modules) and a guard (`scripts/check-live-trips.mjs`), while `isNull(people.deletedAt)` is hand-typed 73 times, `ne(bookings.status, "cancelled")` 91 times against one exported `seatHeld` (`trips-queries.ts:302`), and 38 modules re-join bookings ⋈ people ⋈ trips. `src/db/schema.ts` is 9,613 lines, 121 tables, 83 enums, 247 indexes, 106 checks and 0 `relations()`; `drizzle.config.ts` names that one file, four sweeps (`export.test.ts`, `delete-path-coverage.test.ts`, `retention.test.ts`, `diver-merge.test.ts`) iterate `Object.values(schema)`, and 8 of the 14 `pnpm task:context` areas in `scripts/task-context-data.mjs` name `src/db/schema.ts` whole as a bounded path. The trips aggregate is where the two module kinds collide: 12 `trips-*.ts` files, 8 named in the barrel `src/db/trips.ts`, 6 in `.claude/rules/db.md:19`, and 14 files outside `src/db` import a sibling directly despite `trips.ts:4-5`'s promise. What is guarded has held — `queryAll`/`check-db-concurrency.mjs` over 120 `DbExecutor` files and 114 `.transaction(` sites, the four schema sweeps, `check-live-trips.mjs`, `check-migrations.mjs`, `check-migration-graph.mjs` — and what is narrated has drifted: `db.md:16` says "8,700 lines", `trips-overview.ts:38` cites a "codes and data, never sentences (AGENTS.md)" rule grep cannot find while 10 db modules call `staffTranslator`/`diverTranslator`, and 3 `src/lib` files (`credentials.ts`, `security-step-up.ts`, `usage/alert-ledger.ts`) run Drizzle queries. The three ideas below name the reader/table grammar and enforce it, make every live predicate one export under one guard, and split the schema along the twelve areas the rules and readers already use.

ideas.title: Every staff page reads through one reader; tables keep transitions
ideas.reading: `src/db` holds 129 non-seed query modules of two unnamed kinds side by side: table modules (`bookings.ts`, `orders.ts`, `waivers.ts`, `gear.ts`) and surface readers named for a page's question (`today.ts`, `closeout.ts`, `roster-facts.ts`, `departures-board.ts`, `boat-line.ts`, `first-day.ts`, `trips-overview.ts`, `trips-guests.ts`, `trips-prep.ts`, `crew-sheet.ts`, `print-pass.ts`, `next-dive.ts`). The reader convention lives only in docblocks — `trips-overview.ts:33` "Everything the trip's Overview page is about, in one call", `departures-board.ts:33-42` "the departures board's one reader … detects nothing of its own", `roster-facts.ts:22-26` "No second detector" — and grep finds it in none of AGENTS.md, `.claude/rules/db.md` or `docs/architecture/overview.md`. Where a page has no reader it becomes one: `src/app/shop/[shopSlug]/page.tsx` imports 15 `@/db/` modules (two of them the readers `today` and `closeout`, plus `blockers`, `first-booking`, `form-drafts`, `season-scale`, `orders`, `rental-fit`, `stripe-accounts`, `dive-sites`, `trips`), `trips/[id]/manifest/page.tsx` 12, `orders/page.tsx` 10, `divers/[personId]/page.tsx` 10, and 316 files under `src/app` import `@/db/` directly. The exported verb grammar already separates the kinds — 124 `list*`, 91 `get*`, 18 `count*` reads against 52 `set*`, 35 `record*`, 27 `create*`, 26 `delete*`, 19 `mark*`, 16 `issue*`, 8 `release*`, 7 `claim*`, 6 `consume*`, 6 `restore*` transitions — but 13 `update*` and 13 `save*` stay generic. The trips aggregate shows the kinds colliding: 12 `trips-*.ts` files, of which the barrel `src/db/trips.ts` names 8 and `.claude/rules/db.md:19` names 6, while `trips-overview`/`-guests`/`-prep` are page readers wearing the aggregate's prefix and 14 files outside `src/db` import a sibling directly against `trips.ts:4-5`'s promise. 10 db modules call `staffTranslator(`/`diverTranslator(` (`today.ts` alone imports 55 sentence builders from `@/i18n/today-labels`), while `trips-overview.ts:38` cites a "`src/db` returns codes and data, never sentences (AGENTS.md)" rule that grep cannot find in AGENTS.md or any rule file. `scripts/check-architecture.mjs:59` bans only direction from `src/db`; every other promise the layer makes is a comment.
ideas.idea: Name the two kinds and write them into `.claude/rules/db.md` as the layer's grammar: a table module (`src/db/<table>.ts`) holds rows and the transitions on them, named by transition (`record`, `mark`, `issue`, `claim`, `release`, `consume`, `restore`, `cancel`) and never `update`/`save`; a surface reader (`src/db/<surface>.ts`) answers one page's question in one call, detects nothing of its own, and returns codes and data, never a sentence. Every staff `page.tsx` reads through `requireShopSurface` plus exactly one reader, so the four pages importing 10–15 modules get `getShopHome`, `getTripManifest`, `getOrdersIndex` and `getDiverRecord`, each with a `src/test/query-count.ts` budget, and the 13 pages already at one import are the model. `trips-overview/-guests/-prep.ts` drop the `trips-` prefix (they are readers, not the aggregate), the barrel then covers exactly the departure aggregate, and `scripts/check-architecture.mjs` refuses deep imports into `@/db/trips-*` and `@/db/seed-*` the way it already refuses them into `src/features/*/`. The same table gets two more rows: `src/db` may not import a translator (`@/i18n/messages`, `@/i18n/staff-messages`), and `src/lib` may not import `drizzle-orm` or table values from `@/db/schema` — moving the query halves of `src/lib/credentials.ts`, `security-step-up.ts` and `usage/alert-ledger.ts` into the `src/db` twin the 52 name pairs already model, and the 10 translator callers' sentences to where the translator lives. The stale narrations (`trips.ts:4`, `trips-overview.ts:38`, `db.md:19`) are deleted in favour of the guard's name. Afterwards a page's question has one place to be answered, a table's transitions one place to be written, "a second detector" a rule to be refused by, and a promise about the layer is a grep of one script.
ideas.dissolves: The unnamed third kind of module — a `page.tsx` that is itself a reader over 10–15 db modules — and the `trips-` prefix on three page readers, the generic `update*`/`save*` verbs, and four docblock promises that drifted.
ideas.scope: .claude/rules/db.md; docs/architecture/overview.md (layer paragraph); scripts/check-architecture.mjs (+test) with four new rows; src/db/trips-overview.ts, trips-guests.ts, trips-prep.ts renamed and their 6 importers; the 14 barrel-bypassing files; src/app/shop/[shopSlug]/page.tsx, trips/[id]/manifest/page.tsx, orders/page.tsx, divers/[personId]/page.tsx and four new readers; src/db/today.ts + src/i18n/today-labels.ts consumers and the other 9 translator callers; src/lib/credentials.ts, security-step-up.ts, usage/alert-ledger.ts; 13 update*/13 save* renames across src/db and their callers; docs/agents/repo-checks.md; AGENTS.md check:repo count.
ideas.firstSlice: Write the two-kind rule into `.claude/rules/db.md`, rename `trips-overview/-guests/-prep.ts` out of the aggregate prefix, and add the `@/db/trips-*`/`@/db/seed-*` deep-import refusal to `scripts/check-architecture.mjs`, fixing its 14 hits (7 of which vanish under L18-2's `live.ts`).
ideas.conflicts: ADR 20260803-seed-scenario-modules — keeps its flat-sibling ruling (no `src/db/read/` directory), only the naming changes; ADR 20260730-feature-module-contracts — borrows its deep-import refusal for the trips barrel; ADR 20260827-people-not-lists decision 2 — `roster-facts.ts` is the model reader, unchanged; issue #632 lineage (`getTripPrep`/`getTripOverview`/`getTripGuests`) — completed and generalized rather than restated; issue #1813 (seed crew writes through `setTripCrew`) — subsumed by "one transition path per write"; docs/product/features/roadmap.md concept-model rows — untouched, this is codebase shape not product concept.

ideas.title: Twenty-two soft-deleted tables get one live predicate and one guard
ideas.reading: 22 tables in `src/db/schema.ts` carry `deleted_at`, and exactly one has a named predicate and a guard: `liveTrip()` in `src/db/trips-live.ts`, used in 62 modules and enforced by `scripts/check-live-trips.mjs`, whose own header (lines 11-16) names the failure it exists for — a forgotten reader showing an anonymous visitor a departure the shop took off the board. The other 21 are spelled by hand: `isNull(people.deletedAt)` 73 times, `certifications` 25, `nitroxCertifications` 21, `diveSites` 19, `specialtyCertifications` 17, `waiverTemplates` 7, `tripLenses` 7, `executedDives` 7, `recapPulses` 6, and the remaining twelve fewer than 6 each — so nothing can say whether a certification reader somewhere shows a card its owner deleted. "A seat is held" has one named spelling, `seatHeld` at `src/db/trips-queries.ts:302` (`SEAT_HELD_STATUSES` = booked, checked_in; 10 uses in `src/db`), beside 91 hand-typed `ne(bookings.status, "cancelled")` — which also counts `no_show` (`booking_status` at `schema.ts:2555-2560`), so two meanings share one unnamed shape and `trips-queries.ts:286-301` spends a paragraph explaining which readers want which. "On the board" is `liveTrip()` composed by hand with `eq(trips.status, "scheduled")` at 62 sites; `departures-board.ts:36-40` lists by name the four readers it must share to avoid a second answer. The seat row — bookings ⋈ people ⋈ trips — is re-joined in 38 modules (49 `bookings→people` sites, 72 `bookings→trips`), with `liveBookingJoin` (`trips-queries.ts:302`) the one exported join. `schema.ts` has 0 `relations()`, so there is no relational-query grammar competing with `.select()` and no reason to add one.
ideas.idea: One module, `src/db/live.ts` (absorbing `trips-live.ts`), exports the predicate every soft-deleted table's readers mean — `liveTrip()`, `livePerson()`, `liveCard()`, `liveSite()`, and one per remaining `deleted_at` table — plus the status-set predicates with their meanings named (`seatHeld`, `seatNotCancelled`, `onTheBoard()` = live + scheduled) and the seat joins (`seatJoin` for bookings→trips, `diverJoin` for bookings→people) as the one spelling of the row 38 modules build. `scripts/check-live-trips.mjs` becomes `check-live-reads.mjs`, driven by a table→predicate map derived from `getTableColumns` so every `deleted_at` column must name an export (a new soft-deleted table without a predicate fails `check:repo`, the failure naming the table), and refuses a `.from(<table>)` or join that carries neither the predicate nor `diveday:allow-deleted-<table>: <why>` — the same window-and-acknowledgement mechanics the trips guard already proves. `ne(bookings.status, "cancelled")` is refused outright in favour of `seatNotCancelled`, so a reader states which of the two meanings it wants. The mechanical half of `.claude/rules/db.md`'s "every delete is soft" rule then covers every table, not one, and `docs/agents/repo-checks.md`'s live-trips entry becomes the live-reads entry. Afterwards a reader says what it means in one identifier — `onTheBoard()`, `seatHeld` — and a reviewer greps a name instead of reading a clause.
ideas.dissolves: Nine hand-typed live clauses (about 180 sites), the unnamed "not cancelled" meaning (91 sites), the hand-composed "on the board" pair (62 sites), and a guard that protects one table out of twenty-two.
ideas.scope: src/db/live.ts (new; replaces src/db/trips-live.ts and its 7 outside importers); ~350 call sites across src/db, src/lib, src/features, src/app; scripts/check-live-trips.mjs → check-live-reads.mjs + its test; docs/agents/repo-checks.md; .claude/rules/db.md (soft-delete section); AGENTS.md check:repo count row; ADR amending 20260820-every-delete-is-soft.
ideas.firstSlice: Create `src/db/live.ts` with `livePerson()` and `seatNotCancelled`, codemod the 73 + 91 spellings, and teach the guard a two-row map (trips, people) — the generalization proven on the two widest tables before the map is derived from the schema.
ideas.conflicts: ADR 20260820-every-delete-is-soft — extends its guard from one table to all 22, amends rather than supersedes; ADR 20260827-people-not-lists — `roster-facts.ts` already reads through `liveTrip()` and would read through `seatJoin`; `src/lib/no-show.ts` `SEAT_HELD_STATUSES` — stays the source of the status set, `live.ts` only names the Drizzle predicate over it; docs/design/settled-questions.md — nothing there touches predicates; no open issue in open-issues.md concerns soft-delete reads.

ideas.title: The schema is twelve area files, not one 9,613-line file
ideas.reading: `src/db/schema.ts` is 9,613 lines holding 121 tables and 83 enums interleaved (first enum at line 41, last at 9,384), 87 of the tables carrying a docblock and no area divider anywhere — a grep for section comments finds only per-table docblocks. The repository's context economy is built on bounding — the Read guard refuses any file over 600 lines whole, `.claude/rules/*.md` load by path, `pnpm task:context <area>` names bounded paths — yet 8 of the 14 areas in `scripts/task-context-data.mjs` can only name `src/db/schema.ts` whole, and `.claude/rules/db.md:16` carries a hand-written "8,700 lines" already 913 lines stale. Grouped by the seams the rules and readers already use, the 121 tables fall into twelve areas: board 1,938 lines (24 tables), core 1,553 (16), money 1,132 (15), readiness 1,104 (7), seats 1,052 (18), waivers 528 (4), recap 490 (7), day-of 462 (7), messages 444 (7), integrations 413 (8), gear 245 (4), crew 183 (4). The reasons on record for one file are not about one file: ADR 0005 says "`src/db/schema.ts` is the single source of truth" (a directory with an index is still one source), `docs/architecture/overview.md:63` keeps tables out of `src/features/*` so "a feature owns its rows' lifecycle, not their definition" (an argument against feature ownership, not against `src/db/schema/*`), and ADR 20260803's rejection of a `seed/` directory was that `seed.ts` and `seed/` would both answer `@/db/seed`, which does not arise once `schema.ts` is gone. The mechanics tolerate a split: `drizzle.config.ts` `schema:` takes a directory or glob, the four sweeps and the 140 outside importers use `@/db/schema` as a namespace an `index.ts` re-export preserves, and all 321 cross-table references in `schema.ts` are lazy callbacks (316 inline `() =>`, 5 typed or multi-line) inside 116 third-argument callbacks with 0 module-scope cross-table expressions, so import order cannot bite. H-49 makes this a file move with no migration: no table or column name changes, so `pnpm db:generate` must emit nothing.
ideas.idea: `src/db/schema.ts` becomes `src/db/schema/` with one file per area named for the seam the readers already use — `core.ts`, `board.ts`, `seats.ts`, `money.ts`, `readiness.ts`, `waivers.ts`, `gear.ts`, `crew.ts`, `messages.ts`, `integrations.ts`, `day-of.ts`, `recap.ts` — each holding its tables and the enums only it uses, and an `index.ts` re-exporting everything so `@/db/schema`, the four sweeps and `drizzle-kit` see one namespace. The area files form a DAG rooted at `core.ts` (`shops`, `people`, `personRoles`, `userAccounts`, the token tables), `board.ts` above it, `seats.ts` on both, and `scripts/check-architecture.mjs` gets one row refusing an upward import between area files, so a cycle is a lint failure rather than a runtime surprise. `scripts/task-context-data.mjs` then names `src/db/schema/gear.ts` (245 lines) for gear instead of 9,613, a path-scoped rule can point at an area's tables, and seven of the twelve files pass the 600-line Read guard whole. The hand-written line count leaves `.claude/rules/db.md`, and the reason for the shape — bounded context for the agents that develop this repository, the same reason `.claude/rules/` is path-scoped — is written in the ADR that supersedes 0005's file-location clause. Nothing about a table changes: same names, same constraints, same baseline migration, and an empty `pnpm db:generate` is the proof.
ideas.dissolves: The one 9,613-line file every area rule, every task context and every schema Read has to grep across, and the stale line count that stands in for a map.
ideas.scope: src/db/schema.ts → src/db/schema/{index,core,board,seats,money,readiness,waivers,gear,crew,messages,integrations,day-of,recap}.ts; drizzle.config.ts; scripts/task-context-data.mjs (8 area entries); scripts/check-architecture.mjs (one row + test); .claude/rules/db.md:15-16; docs/architecture/overview.md:63; AGENTS.md route-map row "DB schema"; an ADR superseding ADR 0005's file clause; the schema-change skill's "edit src/db/schema.ts" line; no migration, no message bundle, no e2e spec, no baseline.
ideas.firstSlice: Move the four gear tables (245 lines, `gearItems`, `gearServiceEvents`, `gearReservations`, `priorGearAssignments`) and their enums into `src/db/schema/gear.ts`, add `index.ts` re-exporting `./gear` and the remainder, point `drizzle.config.ts` at the directory, and prove `pnpm db:generate` emits nothing and the four sweeps still count 121 tables.
